control.plant: edge_f32: the camera's edge pixels' coverage stopped in float32's arithmetic only, a float32-only defect in the camera's derivative (the coverage is written so that no near-equal numbers are subtracted, so that it holds in float32: a defect of that guard shows in float32 alone).
